# Pricing

Every plan includes unlimited widgets.

## Plans

| Plan | Price | Requests per month |
|---|---:|---:|
| Free | $0 | 100,000 |
| Pro | $12 | 10,000,000 |
| Team | $49 | 100,000,000 |

## Free plan limits

The free plan is limited to 100,000 requests per month and one custom domain.
When the limit is reached, widgets keep rendering but analytics pause until the
next billing cycle.

## Refunds

Annual plans are refundable within 30 days.
